tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — the warm beige paper behind the Meliponário Isobe logo (#F7F1E5). In dark, a warm cocoa-black.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the hive details panel, map controls.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table stripes, the notes box in HiveDetails — a step darker than the beige page.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside cards and lists. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-control borders; 3:1+ on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the brand's fine outline (logo, hive icon, borders). 15:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, scientific names; on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and the honey tints (6:1+).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on ink-filled chips and the map's code labels.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The main brand colour — pastel yellow (Jasmine). Primary button fill, selected states, the selected hive's number pill. Always carries on-primary text (13:1) and an ink outline; never text on surface (1.2:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Secondary colour — pastel orange honey. Section outlines and 'Setor' tags on the map, small accents and illustration blocks. Never the main action or a large fill; always ink text on it (11:1).

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on amber.

tokens.name: hive-lid
tokens.usage: The hive box's lid — a saturated honey yellow, lighter than the body. Same for every hive; never a status colour.

tokens.name: hive-body
tokens.usage: The hive box's body — saturated golden yellow, deliberately richer than the pastel UI so the boxes pop on the map. Same for every hive; status lives only in the circle beside it.

tokens.name: propolis
tokens.usage: Accent text and links — the headset brown. 5.2:1 on surface, 4.7:1 on surface-sunken (light); 6:1+ on dark surface.

tokens.name: cocoa
tokens.usage: The bot avatar's dark stripe; dark blocks on the cover, the map's backdrop and its code pills. Honey-cornsilk text on it.

tokens.name: wing
tokens.usage: Bot avatar wings; soft highlight fills behind ink text (13:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid focus ring (stroke-focus, 2px) with 2px offset on every focusable element; 5:1 on light surfaces, 11:1 on dark.

tokens.name: honey-cornsilk
tokens.usage: Palette 'Cornsilk' FDF8E1 — the lightest honey tint: code-pill text on cocoa, the logo disc on dark grounds.

tokens.name: honey-lemon-chiffon
tokens.usage: Palette 'Lemon chiffon' FDF4CB — hover fill on light rows and list items.

tokens.name: honey-vanilla
tokens.usage: Palette 'Vanilla' FCEFB4 — selected row / active filter fill behind ink text.

tokens.name: honey-jasmine
tokens.usage: Palette 'Jasmine' FAE588 — the value behind primary; highlight chips (ink text 13:1).

tokens.name: honey-naples
tokens.usage: Palette 'Naples yellow' F9DC5C — the brightest palette yellow: primary-button hover, cover blocks, honey pots in Backdrop; ink text only.

tokens.name: status-stable
tokens.usage: Hive status 'Estável' — green (the darker of the two greens). Circle and badge fill; always with the ✓ glyph and the word.

tokens.name: on-status-stable
tokens.usage: Glyph/text on status-stable (5.5:1 light, 4.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-developing
tokens.usage: Hive status 'Desenvolvendo' — yellow. Its circle sits on the yellow hive box, so the ink ring and ↑ glyph carry it; always with the word in badges.

tokens.name: on-status-developing
tokens.usage: Glyph/text on status-developing (10:1+).

tokens.name: status-recovering
tokens.usage: Hive status 'Recuperando' — red. Same lightness as stable's green, so never tell them apart by colour alone: always the ↻ glyph and the word.

tokens.name: on-status-recovering
tokens.usage: Glyph/text on status-recovering (5.6:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-lost
tokens.usage: Hive status 'Perdida' — grey. Always with the × glyph and the word.

tokens.name: on-status-lost
tokens.usage: Glyph/text on status-lost (5.7:1 light, 5.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-sold
tokens.usage: Hive status 'Vendida' — the lightest green (3.5:1 lighter than stable's green). Always with the ↗ glyph and the word.

tokens.name: on-status-sold
tokens.usage: Glyph/text on status-sold (10.5:1 light, 12:1 dark).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Product name on splash and cover only.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, section names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Colônia forte, com potes de mel bem fechados.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Map attribution, footnotes. Not for anything essential.

styles.name: hive-code
styles.usage: Hive numbers everywhere (map pills, inline text). Always mono, numbers only — no section prefix.

styles.name: hive-code-lg
styles.usage: Hive number as the title of the details card, under the 'Colmeia' label.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; marker label offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside badges, between legend items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding x2; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; default gap; the map's control inset.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; between field groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page top/bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero spacing, cover insets.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges' inner chips, inputs, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, map control stack, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the details panel, the map frame, the bot link card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, filter chips, the code label under a marker.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and the details panel resting on the page.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: A soft lift under primary buttons only. No hard offsets: the brand is delicate.

tokens.name: shadow-map
tokens.usage: Anything floating over the satellite basemap (controls, panel, legend).

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers (line) and the outline of large containers: cards, the map frame, floating map panels — in ink.

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: Outline of buttons, the selected code pill and small round frames (avatar, logo disc). Fine and even, like the logo's single rounded stroke.

tokens.name: stroke-marker
tokens.usage: Dashed section outlines on the map.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width — kept at 2px so keyboard focus stays visible even though the brand line is fine.
